content: I wanted to use mkElabAttribute for a project of mine, but my Rust instincts are screaming at me that this is probably a bad idea since this definition is marked as unsafe. I wanted to know what considerations I needed to make to ensure I was using the definition safely. This is probably equivalent to asking why KeyedDeclsAttribute.init is unsafe, since that's the source of unsafe in mkElabAttribute. Is it just because it's not enforcing this invariant of KeyedDeclsAttribute, so I need to make sure it's enforced myself?

Would it make sense to add a comment (i.e.) on top of these definitions explaining this? Just saying because it seems like the moment I asked the question I found the answer, but I had actually been wondering this for a couple of days at this point. It may save someone else some time
Yes. You can change them to docstrings
I guess this ultimately stems from using docs#Lean.Environment.evalConst / lean_eval_const
